record_type_quote: Nine independent research teams comprising doctoral students and faculty mentors conducted independent reproductions, exact replications, and constructive replications across multiple industries and an extended timeframe (1974-2022).

targets.evidence_quote: This study presents a systematic replication of Kim, Shaver, and Funk's (2022) novel framework for measuring the dynamics of industry clusters.
targets.outcome_quote: Our reproductions and exact replications validate the original findings reported by Kim et al. (2022) for the semiconductor industry, confirming the reliability of the measurement framework.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit validation verdict covers the original semiconductor findings. The abstract also reports reproductions but does not establish numerical agreement or robustness on the original data; supplemental axes are unresolved.

reasoning: Mixed replication/reproduction project, classified as replication because it includes exact and constructive replications on extended periods and other industries. One original paper explicitly named; full reference unavailable, so surname-only citation and year are preserved and title/DOI left blank. The assigned publication is abstract-only; not treated as full text.
